To Whom It May Concern,  

I’ve collaborated closely with Chioma Eze over the past year at E-Commerce Solutions Inc., where she’s been a critical part of our QA team. As a peer, I’ve observed her daily contributions to improving our testing processes and product reliability.  

Chioma’s expertise in test automation and Selenium/Playwright stands out. She spearheaded the automation of our checkout flow, reducing manual testing hours by 30% and catching a critical race condition in the payment gateway. Her Python scripts for data validation also streamlined our reporting process, cutting down on redundant checks. Beyond tools, her attention to edge cases—like handling concurrent user sessions—has strengthened our system’s resilience.  

One standout moment was her initiative to integrate CI/CD pipelines with our test suite. By automating regression tests on every code push, she slashed our feedback loop from hours to minutes, enabling faster fixes. She also designed a REST API mock server for integration testing, which became a reusable asset across teams.  

Chioma’s work ethic is equally impressive. She’s methodical, proactive, and unafraid to challenge assumptions. Whether debugging complex issues or mentoring junior testers, she balances technical rigor with approachability.  

In summary, Chioma’s technical acumen, problem-solving mindset, and dedication to quality make her a strong fit for any high-performing team. I’m confident she’ll bring the same rigor and impact to your organization.  

Sincerely,  
[Your Full Name]
